errors.text_span: 按从大到小排列依次为
errors.evidence: The description claims the slices of the main pie chart are arranged in descending order of size, but they are not. For example, category B (25.3%) is larger than category C (20.7%), but C is listed before B in the description. The visual arrangement in the chart is also not sorted by size.
The color for category B (25.3%) is a purplish-blue, not dark blue. The description also lists this category after category C (20.7%) in what is supposed to be a descending list.

errors.text_span: 其内部进一步细分为三个子类别
errors.evidence: The description states that the 'Healthy lifestyle' category is subdivided into three subcategories, but the exploded pie chart clearly shows four slices: D1, D2, D3, and D0.
The color of the D1 slice is medium blue, not dark blue. The D2 slice is the dark blue one.
The color of the D3 slice is light blue, not dark blue.
